title: First  order amazing second order was water !!
text: First  order amazing second order was water !!. The first order that I ordered from this company the smell was amazing !!! I ordered a lot more from them and some was lost in the mail some was undeliverable then the second order that I got had no smell at all it was plain water I was very upset I was hoping that this would be a company that I could order from many many times but I am so scared to order anything again I don’t want to pay good money for water 😡 so I am guessing some of their bottles are good to get you hooked and then they watered some of them down which has no smell at all!!! I would have been a great repeat customer but I don’t like to get ripped off.
